problem: High-frequency imitation of precise contact-rich manipulation suffers from compounding errors and non-Markovian, variable human demonstrations on inexpensive arms.
contribution: ALOHA teleoperation hardware plus ACT: observation-conditioned action chunks and a conditional latent-variable training objective, with overlapping predictions combined at deployment.
algorithm: A transformer CVAE encodes current proprioception and demonstrated action chunks into a Gaussian style posterior. The policy combines camera features, joint state and style to predict a chunk; training adds reconstruction and KL penalties. Inference uses zero style and can ensemble predictions for the same future instant.
observations: Four 480x640 RGB views and fourteen current follower joint/gripper positions; current observation rather than privileged world state.
actions: Fourteen absolute joint/gripper position targets from the leader arms, tracked by follower motor PID at50Hz. Targets differ conceptually from measured follower positions and encode commanded effort through tracking error.
embodiment_and_data: Two7-DoF ALOHA arms. Six real tasks generally use50demonstrations, Thread Velcro100; two simulated tasks use50successful scripted or human demonstrations. Main real-task evaluation uses one training seed.
experiments: Real Slide Ziploc, Slot Battery, Open Cup, Thread Velcro, Prep Tape and Put On Shoe; simulation cube transfer and bimanual insertion. Stage outcomes expose where full-task success degrades. Chunking, temporal ensembling and CVAE are ablated; frequency user study is separate from autonomous task success.
baselines: BC-ConvMLP, BeT, RT-1 and VINN inTableI; remaining real tasks compare the strongest baseline BeT. Baselines are tuned on cube transfer, with appendix reporting altered history/retrieval settings.

quantitative_result.note: These are sourcepaper conditions, not Explorer performance. Thread Velcro finalsuccess is20% inTableII despite92% firststage.

limitations: Thin dark deformable objects are hard to localize; Velcro frequently fails at grasp/insertion. One real seed and25trials do not establish broad robot/object transfer. Demonstration coverage and camera setup remain task-specific; visual-only outcomes do not measure force.
hardware_adaptation: Reuse the maintained LeRobot ACT implementation with a pinned version and measuredNX batch sizes. SO101/ROSMASTER action ordering, units, normalization, cameraorientation and target-vs-measured semantics must be explicit. Do not load the original fourteen-actuator actionhead into a different arm.
algorithm_detail: PaperAlgorithm1 gives MSE reconstruction plus betaKL; the inspected officialpolicy.py instead computes maskedL1 plus weightedKL. It normalizes images with ImageNet mean/std, truncates to num_queries and masks padded actions. Training posterior uses demonstrated actions; inference does not. Record this implementation difference rather than claiming exact paper parity.
integration_contract: A checkpoint must bind action feature names/order/dimensions and camera bindings/rotation/FPS, normalizationprocessor hashes and hardware limits. Officialcurrent LeRobot remote inference admits ACT only with temporal ensembling disabled and a position-hold driver; compare this changed inference recipe separately from original per-tick ensembling.
license_evidence: MIT code indicated by primaryGitHub API metadata at2026-10-26; pinned source exists and corepolicy was read. Model/data rights were not independently audited, so they are not granted by the code license.
required_experiments: Real forward/backward and checkpoint reload onNX; independent simrollout without privileged leakage; chunk/freshness and position-hold contract tests; camera/action schema roundtrip; supervised physical trials only after separate approval; compare chunking/ensembling choices under equalconditions.
difference_from_explorer: ACT provides a reusable imitation learner, not evidence-grounded cross-robot skillmemory, retention, fault attribution or verified multi-robot release. Explorer must demonstrate those claims with separate baselines rather than relabel ACT.
